## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      3 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 8 abr 2026 - 30 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _FM_, 30 ago 2026, 1/5: "buggy after saving run causes white screen freeze pleas fix it asap"
            2. _Bluesdude55_, 20 ago 2026, 1/5: "Poor and getting worse on Android...Sign in / Login issues everytime. Wasting too much time before being able to open app & start activity. No default setting retention. Auto Pause & type of activity setting should be set/forget similar to the Audio stat choice that remain checked or enabled. Actively looking for new app that works on the first launch. Purchase Information incorrect shows that I have over 400 days left on my subscription but using Free App Go version. don't recommend."
            3. _Mikołaj Ściobłowski_, 8 abr 2026, 1/5: "Laughably bad programming. The voiceover will spam you with useless info instead of playing interval audio cues, a bug that was present FIVE YEARS ago. [08/04/26] The most poorly coded running app managed to get even worse, it doesn't even launch now, congrats asics."
<!--/ir-theme-->
